title: 字符流
summary: 实现查询器，每次接收一个字母，若迄今字符流的某个后缀等于词表中的任一单词则返回真。
insight: 把单词倒序插入字典树；保留最近的字符流，从最新字符向前沿树走，任意经过单词结尾即可匹配后缀。
pitfalls: 匹配必须以当前查询字符结尾
历史只需保留最长单词长度
遇到不存在的树边即可停止

solutions.title: 反向字典树后缀查询
solutions.idea: 把后缀匹配转成从最新字符开始的前缀查找。
steps: 构造 TrieNode，单词从末位向首位插入并标记 end，记录 maxLength
query 追加字符，历史超过 maxLength 时删除最旧字符
从历史末端向前遍历 trie；边不存在返回 false，节点 end 返回 true，走完返回 false

code.java: class StreamChecker { static class Node{Node[] next=new Node[26];boolean end;}private final Node root=new Node();private final StringBuilder history=new StringBuilder();private int maximum;public StreamChecker(String[] words){for(String word:words){maximum=Math.max(maximum,word.length());Node node=root;for(int i=word.length()-1;i>=0;i--){int index=word.charAt(i)-'a';if(node.next[index]==null)node.next[index]=new Node();node=node.next[index];}node.end=true;}}public boolean query(char letter){history.append(letter);if(history.length()>maximum)history.deleteCharAt(0);Node node=root;for(int i=history.length()-1;i>=0;i--){node=node.next[history.charAt(i)-'a'];if(node==null)return false;if(node.end)return true;}return false;} }
code.kotlin: class StreamChecker(words:Array<String>){private class Node{val next=arrayOfNulls<Node>(26);var end=false};private val root=Node();private val history=StringBuilder();private var maximum=0;init{for(word in words){maximum=maxOf(maximum,word.length);var node=root;for(i in word.lastIndex downTo 0){val index=word[i]-'a';if(node.next[index]==null)node.next[index]=Node();node=node.next[index]!!};node.end=true}};fun query(letter:Char):Boolean{history.append(letter);if(history.length>maximum)history.deleteCharAt(0);var node:Node?=root;for(i in history.lastIndex downTo 0){node=node?.next?.get(history[i]-'a')?:return false;if(node.end)return true};return false} }
code.cpp: class StreamChecker { struct Node{array<Node*,26> next{};bool end=false;};Node* root=new Node();string history;int maximum=0;public:StreamChecker(vector<string>& words){for(string& word:words){maximum=max(maximum,(int)word.size());Node* node=root;for(auto it=word.rbegin();it!=word.rend();++it){int index=*it-'a';if(!node->next[index])node->next[index]=new Node();node=node->next[index];}node->end=true;}}bool query(char letter){history+=letter;if((int)history.size()>maximum)history.erase(history.begin());Node* node=root;for(auto it=history.rbegin();it!=history.rend();++it){node=node->next[*it-'a'];if(!node)return false;if(node->end)return true;}return false;} };
